questions.prompt: What is a common use for for...of?
options: Reading only enumerable property names from a plain object.
Creating a deep copy of every value.
Iterating over values provided by an iterable.
questions.explanation: for...of consumes iterable values; for...in enumerates property keys.

questions.prompt: What should you remember about spread syntax on an object with nested objects?
options: The copy is shallow; nested object references can still be shared.
It always performs a deep clone.
It serializes the object to JSON.
questions.explanation: Spread copies enumerable own properties one level deep, so nested objects may still be aliased.
